 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Fulham get aught trying to play out from the back and Leon Goretzka gets a shot away but can't keep it on target. It comes to Alysson who goes down in the box looking for another penalty but he won't get it.

 Fulham have been pretty much camped in their own half for this opening 20 minutes.
 Villa hemming them in.

 'It's just too much elevation' published at 20:18 GMT 20:18 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sports 
 What a let off for Fulham. For all the players you had nailed on to score this, it would be John McGinn. 
 He leans back a bit, he hits it well but it's just too much elevation.

 MISSED PENALTY - ASTON VILLA published at 16 mins 16 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 John McGinn leans back a bit and he slams his penalty off the cross bar!
 An unexpected miss from the Villa captain but a big let off for Fulham.

 John McGinn places the ball on the spot in front of the empty construction site of the north stand...

 You can see why the referee doesn't see it in open play but there's no reason for Sander Berge's arm to be up there.

 Image source, Getty Images 
 80 235 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 11 mins 11 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 A bright start to the game, this.
 Aston Villa win a couple of corners. The first comes to nothing before the second is headed straight to the gloves of Bernd Leno by Leon Gortezka.
 48 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 8 mins 8 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Nervy moment for Fulham as Shea Charles gets caught in possession in his own penalty box and the ball comes to Johan Manzambi but his effort is blocked.
 91 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'I have to find solutions' published at 20:09 GMT 20:09 GMT 
 FT: Tottenham 2-0 Crystal Palace 
 Crystal Palace 
 Crystal Palace boss Pierre Sage, speaking to BBC MOTD about Jean-Philippe Mateta's red card: "No, I think the decision is normal. We touched a player where we couldn't touch him. That is why the red card came. I have nothing to comment on.
 "We chose to be more compact and to let the ball to the opponent, and we took this first goal on set-pieces. During half-time, we take other objective to stay like this until minute 75."
 On the future: "I am the first to help the team. For sure, I have things to do. That is why I make the plan to come back after minute 75 with substitutions. 
 "Hopefully, it was not as we expected, but I am the first responsible for things. I have to find solutions. You can trust in me, that I will be on the pitch on Monday and to push for the team to win against Liverpool.
 "It is a problem with performance at the moment as a team we can be better, especially with the ball."
 12 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 7 mins 7 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Aston Villa are crying out for a penalty but they're not going to get one.
 They do win a corner and Leon Goretzka has almost a free header but it's over the bar.
 50 22 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 6 mins 6 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 It was good work from Oscar Bobb down the right-hand side to set up that opportunity.
 Another player who seems to be finding a bit of form for Fulham.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 50 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 5 mins 5 mins 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Massive opportunity for Fulham to take an early lead.
 Goncalo Garcia cuts it back fort Alex Iwobi but it just takes a little deflection off Victor Lindelof on its way to him and that means he's not quite able to get his effort under control and blasts it over the bar.
 Big chance.
 37 73 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Jackson has been a joy to watch' published at 20:05 GMT 20:05 GMT 
 Aston Villa 0-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sports 
 Nicolas Jackson has been a joy to watch under Unai Emery this season. 
 He has the ability to drag the team up the pitch. He's scoring goals and he's been a bonus for the team.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 175 19 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Strange to be at Villa Park on a Saturday night, but really hoping Villa can pick up from last weekend and take the 3 points ahead of Barcelona on Tuesday.
